action.description: A built-in action, or one the host page registered with popui.actions.register(name, fn) and allows.

Action.description: An action to run in response to an event.

initial.description:
Initial is the text shown when no image child is provided. Up to
three characters are rendered; anything longer is truncated.

color.description:
Color is a foreground color token name applied to the initials:
accent, success, warning, critical, info, document-xml,
document-pdf or document-png. Empty uses the default secondary
foreground.

Avatar.description: Avatar provides props for the avatar component

variant.description:
Variant defines the button style variant, see the ButtonVariant constants.
Default is "primary".

size.description: Size defines the button size, see the ButtonSize constants.

type.description: Type determines the type of button, e.g., "button", "submit", "reset".

name.description: Name sets the name attribute of the button for the form.

value.description: Value sets the value attribute of the button for the form.

form.description: Form associates the button with a form element by its ID.

disabled.description: Disabled when true disables the button.

autofocus.description: Autofocus when true sets the autofocus attribute on the button.

copy.description:
Copy, when set, turns the button into a copy-to-clipboard control:
the (truncated) value renders in mono next to a duplicate icon that
flips to a tick on success, and clicking copies the full value.
Children render after the copy content. Ignored on anchor buttons.

copyPrefixLength.description:
CopyPrefixLength / CopySuffixLength truncate the DISPLAYED value to
"prefix…suffix"; the full Copy value is what lands on the clipboard.
Both 0 show the value untruncated.

href.description: Href enables anchor button behavior as opposed to a form button.

target.description: Target determines where to open the linked document.

rel.description:
Rel specifies the relationship between the current document and the
linked document.

download.description:
Download when true indicates that the linked resource is intended to be
downloaded rather than displayed in the browser.

showSpinnerOnClick.description: ShowSpinnerOnClick when true shows a loading spinner on the button when clicked.

popoverTarget.description:
PopoverTarget specifies the ID of a popover element to control.
When set, clicking the button will show/hide the associated popover.

popoverTargetAction.description:
PopoverTargetAction specifies the action to perform on the popover.
Valid values are "toggle" (default), "show", or "hide".

Button.description: Button defines the properties for a button component.

align.description:
Align defines the horizontal alignment of buttons within the group.
Valid values are "left" (default), "center", or "right".

ButtonGroup.description: ButtonGroup is used with buttons components that usually contain multiple buttons in a row.

order.description:
Order positions the card inside a reorderable CardDeck, 1-based, and
renders as `data-order`. The deck sorts its cards by it on load and
renumbers every card to 1..n after each move, so the attribute, the
DOM sequence and the visible sequence are always the same list — read
it back to persist an order. Cards without one sink to the end of the
deck, keeping the sequence they were rendered in. Ignored outside a
reorderable deck, where the rendered sequence is already the order.

variant.description:
Variant specifies the style of the checkbox, e.g.,
`CheckboxVariantSwitch` for toggle switch style.

label.description: Label is the text label associated with the checkbox.

description.description:
Description is additional descriptive text for the checkbox that will
be shown below the label.

Checkbox.description: Checkbox defines the properties for checkbox inputs.

DD.description: DD defines the props for the DD component (definition description).

DT.description: DT defines the props for the DT component (definition term).

Description.description: Description defines the props for the Description component.

DescriptionList.description: DescriptionList defines the props for the DescriptionList component.

copy.description: Copy, when set, wires the button to copy this text to the clipboard.

url.description:
URL, when set, renders the button as an anchor that opens the URL in a new
tab (target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer).

attributes.description:
Attributes wire extra behavior/extras on the button (aria-label, onclick,
…) and override the defaults a Copy / URL action sets.

DescriptionListAction.description: DescriptionListAction is one hover-revealed action button on a DescriptionListItem's value.

inline.description:
Inline lays the item out as label-left / value-right instead of the
default stacked (label above value).

mono.description: Mono renders the value in the monospace face (ids, hashes).

prefixLength.description:
PrefixLength / SuffixLength truncate the DISPLAYED value to
"prefix…suffix" (or "prefix…" when SuffixLength is 0); the full value is
what Actions like copy act on. Both 0 shows it untruncated.

actions.description:
Actions are hover-revealed buttons rendered next to the value (copy,
external-link, …), in order of placement.

DescriptionListItem.description: DescriptionListItem defines the props for the DescriptionListItem component.

$schema.description:
Schema identifies the JSON Schema of the document so editors can offer
completion and validation. It is ignored when rendering.

data.description:
Data is a JSON object with the document's state. It becomes the
Alpine.js `x-data` of the document, is the source for node "bind" and
"model" values, and is what actions in "on" handlers read and change.
Behaviour is never embedded here: actions are implemented in JS (see
assets/jsonui.js) and only referenced by name.

template.description: Template is the list of nodes to render.

handlers.description:
Handlers are named actions, or lists of actions, that "on" handlers
can refer to by name so a handler used in several places is defined
once, e.g. {"update": {"action": "step.update", "summary": "…"}} and
then {"on": {"change": "update"}}. Handlers can't refer to each other.

Document.description: Document is the root of a JSON UI description.

name.description: Name is the last segment of the path, without the array marker.

path.description:
Path is the full dotted path from the root, with [] marking each array
crossed on the way: lines[].item.name. It is what the picker emits
unless Value overrides it.

value.description:
Value overrides what selecting the field writes into the hidden input
and reports on the select event. Use it when the path the user reads is
not the string the consumer needs — a Go template variable, say.

description.description:
Description is the schema's long description, shown after the path and
as the row's tooltip. It truncates before the path does, and is never
searched: filtering matches the path alone. Optional — goblfields
leaves it out unless asked for, and a row without one shows just its
path.

type.description:
Type is the JSON Schema type: string, object, array, integer, number,
boolean. It picks the icon drawn before the name — A, braces,
brackets, a hash, a switch — unless Icon is set, names the row's
tooltip, and is carried on the select event.

array.description:
Array marks a field that is itself an array. Its children describe one
item, so their paths carry the [] marker of this field.

required.description: Required marks a field its immediate parent requires.

alwaysPresent.description:
AlwaysPresent marks a field required at every step from the root, and
so present on every document of the schema. Inside an array it reads
per item: lines[].item is marked when every line that exists carries an
item. The picker shows these with a green dot.

group.description:
Group marks a heading over the fields beneath it rather than a field
of the data: it opens like an object and its Name is part of the path
the user reads and filters by, but it is left out of what its
descendants emit. It lets one tree hold several — the variables of
each document schema a message might be about, say — without the
grouping changing the values picked. goblfields.Group builds one.

divider.description:
Divider draws a rule above the field's row while browsing, setting it
apart from the rows before it — the document nested under doc after a
run of an app's own variables, say.

children.description:
Children are the fields one level down, for a field that can be drilled
into.

Field.description: Field is one entry in a FieldPicker's tree.

align.description:
Align is which edge of the trigger the panel hangs from: the left by
default, the right with FieldPickerAlignEnd — for a trigger at the
right of its row, so the panel stays over the content.

class.description: Class is applied to the default trigger button.

attributes.description:
Attributes are applied to the component root, the element carrying
x-modelable, so an Alpine x-model there two-way binds the value.

name.description: Name is the hidden input's name, for form submission.

tooltip.description:
Tooltip shows a question mark icon after the label that reveals a
Tooltip card on hover. Only used when Label is set.

triggerLabel.description:
TriggerLabel is the default trigger button's text. Defaults to
"Insert field". Ignored when the children slot supplies the trigger.

value.description:
Value is the initial value. The panel opens where it lives rather
than at the root.

root.description:
Root labels the first breadcrumb in the panel, naming what the tree
describes: "bill/invoice", "envelope".

fields.description: Fields is the tree to pick from.

format.description:
Format wraps a picked path, %s standing for the path: "{{.doc.%s}}"
turns supplier.name into {{.doc.supplier.name}}. Defaults to "%s". A
field with a Value of its own is emitted as is.

target.description:
Target is a CSS selector for an input, textarea or contenteditable
element. When set, a pick is inserted there at the caret, replacing
any selection, with the caret left after it. When the target is a
template editor (a Contenteditable with a VariableFormat), typing the
format's opening characters there — {{ — opens the picker at the
caret with the filter focused, and the pick replaces them.

scalarsOnly.description:
ScalarsOnly makes objects and arrays browse-only: they can be opened
but not picked, and one with nothing underneath is left out.
For a template, where a picked object would print as a Go map dump.
Off by default, since a picker may be choosing a field for its own
sake rather than for its value.

Fieldset.description: Fieldset properties to configure a simple fieldset.

action.description: Action specifies where to send the form data when submitted.

method.description: Method specifies the HTTP method to use when submitting the form (GET, POST, etc.).

enctype.description: Enctype specifies how the form data should be encoded when submitting (e.g., "multipart/form-data").

target.description: Target specifies where to display the response after submitting the form (_self, _blank, etc.).

autocomplete.description: Autocomplete specifies whether the form should have autocomplete on or off.

novalidate.description: Novalidate when true, the form will not be validated when submitted.

acceptCharset.description: AcceptCharset specifies the character encodings used for form submission.

name.description: Name sets the name of the form.

rel.description: Rel specifies the relationship between the current document and the linked document.

Form.description: Form properties to configure a form element with standard HTML form attributes.

anyOf.description: The name of one of the document's handlers.
The name of one of the document's handlers.

tooltip.description:
Tooltip shows a question mark icon after the label that reveals a
Tooltip card on hover. Only used when Label is set.

size.description: Set the height of the input field, see the InputSize constants.

prefix.description: Prefix adds a text just before the input field inside a @Description.

Input.description: Input defines the properties that can be used with input fields.

Node.description: A component in the template, identified by its type.

OptionGroup.description: OptionGroup properties for grouping form elements like checkboxes and radio buttons.

P.description: P defines the props for the P component.

attributes.description:
Attributes are applied to the value-carrying element so a consumer can
attach framework bindings without popui knowing the framework: the
native <select> in the single variant, and the component root in the
Multiple variant (the element exposed via x-modelable, so an Alpine
x-model there two-way binds the selection — e.g.
Attributes: templ.Attributes{"x-model": "line.tags"}).

tooltip.description:
Tooltip shows a question mark icon after the label that reveals a
Tooltip card on hover. Only used when Label is set.

multiple.description: Multiple switches to the tag-chip combobox variant.

placeholder.description:
Placeholder is shown inside the field when nothing is selected
(Multiple variant only).

searchable.description:
Searchable adds a search box inside the dropdown to filter options
(Multiple variant only).

description.description:
Description renders next to the label in a dimmed color, giving extra
context for the option. Only shown by the Multiple variant's dropdown.

SelectOption.description: SelectOption defines an option for a Select component

Separator.description: Separator defines the props for the Separator component.

Subtitle.description: Subtitle defines the props for the Subtitle component.

value.description: Value is the tab this panel belongs to (matches a TabItem.Value).

model.description:
Model is the Alpine variable to test. Defaults to "tab"; set it only when
the parent Tabs uses a custom Model.

Tab.description: Tab is one tab's content panel inside a popui.Tabs.

count.description:
Count renders a counter after the label when greater than zero: "(n)" on
the default variant, a small badge on the pill variant.

title.description:
Title is the trigger's accessible name and tooltip. Set it on an
icon-only tab, where there is no Label to read out.

TabItem.description: TabItem is one entry in a popui.Tabs trigger row: a Value that identifies the tab (assigned to the Alpine Model on click and matched by the content Tab), a visible Label, an optional leading Icon, and an optional Count.

model.description:
Model is the Alpine variable holding the active tab Value. Defaults to
"tab" — match it on the child Tabs (their default is also "tab", so
usually neither needs setting).

active.description:
Active is the tab Value selected on first render. Defaults to the first
tab's Value.

tabs.description: Tabs is the ordered trigger row.

Tabs.description: Tabs is a self-contained tabbed view: it owns the Alpine scope that tracks the active tab, renders the trigger row from Tabs, and hosts one popui.Tab content panel per tab in its children.

status.description: grey, green, yellow, red, orange, blue, purple, olive, teal, crimson, steelBlue, empty

tooltip.description:
Tooltip shows a question mark icon after the label that reveals a
Tooltip card on hover. Only used when Label is set.

monospace.description:
Monospace indicates whether to use a monospace font for the textarea
by adding the appropriate classes.

variableFormat.description:
VariableFormat turns Contenteditable into a template editor. It is the
syntax variables are written in, %s standing for the name: "{{.%s}}"
for a Go template. Each variable in the text is shown as a chip, and
the text with the variables written out — the template itself — is
what Value holds, what is submitted under Name, and what an Alpine
x-model on the component binds. FieldPicker inserts into such an
editor as chips. Textarea ignores it.

viewToggle.description:
ViewToggle adds a Rich / Plain switch above the editor: Rich shows
the chips, Plain shows the template as text, in a monospaced
textarea. Only with VariableFormat.

view.description:
View is the view the editor starts in: ContenteditableViewRich (the
default) or ContenteditableViewPlain. Only with VariableFormat.

picker.description:
Picker puts a FieldPicker in the editor's header, at the right of the
view toggle, as an icon button of the editor's own height, with its
panel hung from the right edge. Its Target is the editor, so a pick
and a typed opening — {{ — both land at the caret. Set the picker's
Fields, Format, ScalarsOnly and the rest as usual; its ID, Target and
Align are the editor's to set. Only with VariableFormat.

Title.description: Title defines the props for the Title component.

horizontal.description:
Horizontal places the description next to the title on the same
baseline, separated by a middot, instead of stacking it below.

TitleGroup.description: TitleGroup defines the props for the TitleGroup component: a title with an optional secondary description, stacked by default or arranged on one baseline with Horizontal.

title.description:
Title is the card heading. Optional, but at least one of Title,
Description or Image must be set for the card to render.

description.description:
Description renders below the title in a muted color, parsed as Markdown:
emphasis, code, links and bullet or numbered lists all work, and a single
newline is a line break, so multi-line text reads as written. Raw HTML is
escaped rather than passed through. Optional, but at least one of Title,
Description or Image must be set for the card to render.

image.description:
Image is the URL of an optional illustration shown above the title.
The component applies the rounded corners and border to it.

delay.description:
Delay is how long the pointer must rest on the trigger, in
milliseconds, before the card appears. Zero (the default) shows it
immediately; set a few hundred for dense surfaces where a card on
every casual hover would be noise. Hiding is never delayed, and
keyboard focus reveals the card immediately regardless.

position.description:
Position places the card relative to the trigger: one of the
TooltipPosition constants. Defaults to top.

The card has no collision detection, so a wide one centered on a trigger
near the edge of its container can overflow. The -start and -end variants
align the card with the trigger's leading or trailing edge instead of
centering it, which keeps it inside the container.

loading.description:
Loading is the data path that is true while a file is being chosen or
uploaded, e.g. the "busy" path of the select action.

UploadFile.description: UploadFile are the props of the "upload_file" node, a file picker row with a preview image and Upload/Remove buttons.

message.description: Text to show; {{path}} placeholders are replaced with data values.

into.description: Data path to store the action's result in.

busy.description: Data path set to true while the action runs.

detail.description: Event detail; defaults to a copy of the document data.

into.description: Data path to store the action's result in.

busy.description: Data path set to true while the action runs.

action.dispatch.description: Dispatch a bubbling DOM CustomEvent for the host page to handle.

into.description: Data path to store the action's result in.

busy.description: Data path set to true while the action runs.

action.reset.description: Restore the document data to its initial values.

value.description: New value; strings may use {{path}} placeholders.

into.description: Data path to store the action's result in.

busy.description: Data path set to true while the action runs.

action.set.description: Set a data path to a value.

children.description: Children are rendered as the component's `{ children... }`.

bind.description: Props to take from the document data, as prop name → data path, e.g. {"value": "customer.name"}. Requires object data; resolved at render time.

on.description:
On maps DOM events, with optional Alpine modifiers such as
"submit.prevent", to an action, the name of one of the document's
handlers, or a list of either to run in order, e.g.
{"click": {"action": "alert", "message": "Hi {{customer.name}}"}} or
{"change": "update"}.

handlers, or a list of either to run in order, e.g.
{"click": {"action": "alert", "message": "Hi {{customer.name}}"}} or
{"change": "update"}.
